company_policies.refund_policy: No refunds are provided after 7 days of purchase. Refund requests within 7 days will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.
company_policies.support: 24/7 live support is available exclusively on the Pro plan. Basic plan users have access to email support during business hours.
company_policies.trial: No free trial is currently available, but users can upgrade or downgrade plans at any time.
company_policies.billing: All plans are billed monthly. Annual billing with a 20% discount is available on request.

about_autostream.description: AutoStream is a SaaS platform that provides automated video editing tools for content creators on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and other platforms.
about_autostream.target_users: Content creators, YouTubers, social media influencers, marketing teams
key_features: Automated video editing powered by AI
